limitations: The actual successful tool reply was discarded at the local callback; this is not a real network interruption.
The first Python process exited normally after saving the uncertain checkpoint; the second was a separate actual process, not an abrupt-kill or power-loss test.
Single worker; no atomic CAS, concurrent-writer fencing or long-term durability proof.
C05/C06 records describe earlier v1/v2 observations. Registry is now v3; old probes must not be blindly replayed.
No Notion resumption, production activation or canonical promotion.
